verdict.rationale: OpenHands has an auto-approve/manual-approve action mode (openhands-docs-3 implies a default confirmation step exists before auto-approve is enabled) and can open PRs after agent work, suggesting some human-in-the-loop gating exists, but there's no explicit documentation of a diff review UI or an approval gate specifically before PR creation. missing for 10: explicit diff-review interface, documented approve/reject step tied to PR creation, evidence of a review-before-merge workflow.
